C0249.title: Supreme People's Procuratorate Releases Typical IP Protection Cases Involving 'Pirate Links' for Copyright Infringement
keywords: right to network dissemination of information
C0249.summary: In 2024, the Supreme People's Procuratorate released typical intellectual property protection cases, with Case 3 being a new type of case in the digital copyright field involving numerous works and an extraordinarily large amount of money. The procuratorial organ accurately determined that the perpetrator used 'pirate links' to disseminate works, infringing upon the right holder's right to network
